_note: Dated rule changes shown on the homepage and /updates. Add new entries at the top; the build sorts by date and marks past ones as in effect automatically.

events.title: Digital KYC from abroad goes live
events.body: SEBI's November 2026 circular lets NRIs, OCIs and foreign nationals in FATF-compliant countries complete KYC and video verification without being in India.

events.title: No TAN needed to buy property from an NRI
events.body: Resident individual buyers can deduct and report tax on purchases from NRI sellers using their PAN, simplifying property sales by non-residents.

events.title: Listed shares opened to all overseas individuals
events.body: FEMA amendment raises the individual limit to 10% and the aggregate limit to 24%, and extends the route beyond NRIs and OCIs.

events.title: “Registered” KYC relaxation ended
events.body: The last extension treating NRIs with Registered status as Validated ran to this date. Check your live status before investing.

events.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 takes effect
events.body: The new Act replaces the 1961 Act. Non-resident withholding moves to section 393; “tax year” replaces previous year and assessment year.

events.title: Union Budget 2026 announces higher limits
events.body: The Budget proposed doubling the individual limit for overseas individuals investing in listed Indian shares.
